intro: Set the room size below. Add unusable corners and extra alcoves to scale.
name: Name
storage: Room templates are stored in this browser. The room is also saved with the track in native JSON.
dragNote: Select an element, enter its size and drag it into place. Arrow keys move by 1 cm. X/Y start at the top left of the base room; negative values lie outside.
saveError: Could not save room. Check dimensions and browser storage.
invalid: Check dimensions: extensions must connect to the room; unusable areas must overlap it.
continue: Save room and continue to track planner
backgroundNote: Scale 1:1 in mm. Blue: usable area; hatched: unusable. The room stays fixed while editing the track.
searchNote: Automatic track suggestions still use the base rectangle. Check alcoves and obstacles in the track planner afterwards.
